# Sabbath Service Desk

> Free church presentation software for Seventh-day Adventist media teams. It shows the Bible, hymns with music, slides, video and announcements on a projector or TV, gives the platform a stage screen, installs from the web browser at https://ssdesk.online/ and works with no internet once installed. Made by Lee McQuire of WiFi vs The Word Ministries, Malmesbury, South Africa. Independent: not an official product of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.

Key facts:
- Price: free, no adverts, no account needed.
- Works offline after the first visit installs it (Bibles, hymns, hymn music and fonts are stored on the device).
- Runs in Chrome or Edge on Windows, Mac and Linux computers (best for a projector), and on Android, iPhone and iPad.
- Built in: King James Version, World English Bible, Afrikaans 1933/53 Bible; English and Afrikaans hymnbooks with offline hymn music. Hymnbooks in more languages (isiXhosa, isiZulu, Sesotho, Setswana, Shona, Swahili, French, Portuguese, Spanish and others) can be added and then work offline.
- Adventist service plans (Divine Service, Sabbath School, Vespers / AY, Communion, Thirteenth Sabbath, Baptism and more), Sabbath times worked out offline, no updates during the Sabbath.
- Stage screen with clock, timers and messages; phone remote with a PIN; PowerPoint, PDF and picture slides; video and music player; banners.
- Optional free companion program for the church PC (Windows, Linux, macOS) links phones, TVs and a second PC over the church network with no internet.
